newsitem.title: USA: Brookdale Living raises $7.2 mln in offer.
newsitem.headline: Brookdale Living raises $7.2 mln in offer.

text.p: Brookdale Living Communities Inc said Monday it will receive net proceeds of about $7.2 million from the sale of 675,000 additional shares of common stock as part of an over-allotment from a previous offering.

Brookdlate said Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc, as representative of the underwriters of Brookdale's initial public offering, exercised the option to buy the shares at $11.50 each, less underwriting discounts and commissions.
Brookdale said it will use proceeds to finance a portion of future acquisitions and developments and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
As a result of the over-allotment, the company's outstanding shares of registered common stock increased to 5,175,000 from 4,500,000. Total outstanding shares rose to 7,175,000 from 6,500,000.
Brookdale provides senior and assisted living services to the elderly, with 10 facilities in five states.
